_comment: Manual dish-grouping overrides. Edit this file by hand when the automatic
prefix matcher gets a dish wrong; entries here always win over the matcher.
'categoryToDish' maps a CBORD categoryId (string) to either:
"Some Dish Name"  -> put this category in that dish. Categories sharing a
name merge into one build-your-own flow, and also
absorb any auto-matched group whose name extends it.
null              -> PIN AS STANDALONE. Withhold the category from the
matcher entirely. Use when many unrelated sections
share a prefix and would otherwise be swept into one
bogus dish (see Freeman Café below).
categoryIds are globally unique across units and, unlike detailOids, are
stable across days — but stations do get added and renamed, so re-audit when
the menu changes. Find current ids via GET /units/{unitId}/dishes or
/menus/{menuOid}/dishes; each section lists its categoryId.
Verified against live menus on 2026-08-24 (fall semester menus).
--- Marketplace: abbreviated Leaf and Ladle salad-bar categories that share
no word prefix with 'Leaf and Ladle'.
--- Ginger + Soy: preset bowls. Each named bowl is a shared base plus its
own toppings/sauces. The matcher can't see this ('Salmon Poke Bowl' and
'Every Day Poke Bowl' share no leading prefix) and separately mis-merged the
two bases into an 'Every Day' dish. Ramen's two categories normalize to the
single word 'ramen', below the matcher's 2-word minimum.
--- The Farmstead: a build-your-own salad bar whose categories are named so
generically (Base / Proteins / Cheese / Vegetables ...) that they share no
words at all. The hot-line categories (Carving Station, Entree, Sandwiches,
Sides) are genuinely separate and are left alone.
--- Freeman Café: every category is prefixed 'Freeman Café', so the matcher
swept the entire cafe into one 11-section pseudo-dish. The real dishes are a
salad builder and a sandwich combo; everything else is pinned standalone.
The BYO Burger categories match correctly on their own and need no entry.
'standaloneUnits' lists venue NAMES (not ids) that are menu sections all the
way down — every category there is returned standalone. Names, because Duke
reassigns unit ids whenever a location is added: 'Red Mango' and 'Sazon'
appearing mid-week shifted every id above them, which would silently point an
id-keyed list at the wrong venue. Matching ignores case and accents.
--- Sazon: a build-your-own whose sections are named 'Choose Base' / 'Choose
Protein' / ... They share only the word 'choose', below the 2-word minimum.
--- Red Mango: one shared bread category plus 15 named presets, each
'<Name> (Choose Your Ingredients)'. Same shape as the Ginger + Soy poke bowls:
no shared prefix ties a preset to the base. Power Bowl is its own build.
--- Freeman coffee (Classics / Specials / Iced variants) share the prefix
'Freeman Café Coffee' but are alternative drinks, not parts of one build.
--- Zweli's: the biscuit/sandwich category plus its 'Breakfast Protein
(Choose 1)' modifier is one flow; sides and pastries are ordered on their own.
